heading: INT. COLLAPSED MINE SHAFT - SIDE CHAMBER - NIGHT

units.text: INT. COLLAPSED MINE SHAFT - SIDE CHAMBER - NIGHT
Rock walls dripping.
A headlamp on the ground throws a ragged yellow cone.
A first-aid kit, half open.
A small digital recorder on a flat stone.
LIV ARNESEN, 30s, caked in dust, one leg stretched stiffly in front of her, props herself against the wall.
She presses the recorder's red button and holds it close.
Day two. Or night two. Hard to say. Battery's at twenty percent. Water's gone. I have three granola bars and a flare.
units.name: LIV

units.text: She coughs, long, into her sleeve.
My name is Liv Arnesen. If someone finds this, tell my mother I wasn't scared. That's a lie, but tell her anyway.
units.name: LIV

units.text: She clicks it off.
Clicks it on.
Day one. I'm okay. The ceiling came down fast. The west tunnel's blocked. Fine, I'll try the north.
units.name: LIV

units.text: She listens with her eyes closed.
Her recorded voice breaks off with a muffled crash, then silence, then breathing.
That was the part where I fell.
units.name: LIV

units.text: She clicks it off.
The truth is, I keep hearing a drip. And I keep hoping it's a river. But it's just a pipe. A leaking pipe.
units.name: LIV

units.text: She moves her leg.
Winces.
Okay. Let's make a plan. One. Don't die. Two. Don't panic. Three. If you panic, see one.
units.name: LIV

units.text: A faint scraping sounds from above.
She freezes.
Waits.
Nothing.
She lets out a breath.
Rats. Probably rats. Or a rescue team with very bad manners.
units.name: LIV

units.text: She laughs.
The laugh turns into a sob.
She presses the heel of her hand to her mouth until it passes.
Sorry. Sorry. Recording. Where was I?
units.name: LIV

units.text: She clicks the button again.
If I get out, I'm taking up pottery. Something slow. Something that doesn't fall on me.
units.name: LIV

units.text: Liv smiles at it, tired and cracked.
You know, that was a good plan.
units.name: LIV

units.text: Overhead, the scraping returns.
Louder.
A thin shaft of white light falls through a crack in the rock.
Hello?
units.name: LIV

units.text: She reaches for the flare, and the rock above her begins to shift.
